faq.q: Is Enclave at Grandview a neighbourhood or a complex?
faq.a: A complex — a named townhome community the live page places at 2979 156 Street in Grandview Surrey, off a no-through street; there is no Enclave board sub-area, and its market frame is the Grandview sub-area row plus the S Surrey White Rock community context

faq.q: Are rentals allowed at Enclave at Grandview?
faq.a: For long-term rentals, the live page states that under BC rules in force since November 24, 2022, no strata may restrict them, while the strata may still have or pass a bylaw on short-term rentals — ask for the current bylaws and strata minutes and confirm any short-term rental rules with the strata manager before buying

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Enclave at Grandview?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Enclave at Grandview is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
